Subject: Vendor setup + payment cadence question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the help getting Skyline set up to purchase Redwood. A couple items from procurement that we need to align on before we can issue POs:

- Our standard terms are Net 45 but the internal billing system requires a consistent invoice-to-PO routing and a canonical PO prefix (we can adapt).
- We may be able to move to Net 30 for faster processing if Redwood can provide an accelerated remit path (ACH routing + single-invoice upload) or an early-pay program.

Short version: can Redwood offer an early-pay option (30-day remittance for a small fee) or provide a PO-to-invoice automation flow that will allow our AP team to pay Net 30?

Attachments: Skyline_PO_0427.xlsx (sample PO our team will send)

If it helps, Alex Grant (cc) is our billing liaison and can provide the internal PO template and ERP details. Would appreciate a one-email summary of the steps we need to complete vendor onboarding and any enrollment for early-pay.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Skyline Systems
procurement@skylinesystems.com

Thanks for the ping, Rishi. Quick runbook below — copied in items we need from Skyline to complete onboarding and evaluate early-pay: 

Vendor onboarding (standard)
- Completed W-9 (required) — attach scanned PDF (W-9_Skyline.pdf)
- Vendor bank details + ACH authorization form (signed)
- Completed vendor profile in our portal (we'll send invite after paperwork)
- Signed PO for initial order (we accept emailed PO+PDF)

Early-pay program (finance-managed)
- Finance runs an eligibility check (credit terms, historical spend, account health).
- If approved, we enroll the vendor in the EarlyPay pilot and set the accelerated remittance window (30 days).
- Fee: typical pilot fee is 1.0% of invoice for 30-day acceleration; Finance may negotiate depending on AR risk.
- Required docs: vendor onboarding checklist (attached), early-pay enrollment form (attached).

Notes / timeline
- If Skyline returns W-9 + ACH + signed PO by end of next week, we can complete portal setup in 3 business days and be invoice-ready.
- Early-pay eligibility decision generally takes 2–4 business days after paperwork + credit check.

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, EarlyPay_Enrollment_Form.pdf

Monica — once they send W-9 and ACH, please kick off the portal invite and tag Finance (fin-ops@redwood.com) on the enrollment form.

Karthik
Head of Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

We can move forward on two parallel tracks:
1) Standard onboarding so you can start sending POs and invoices under Net 45 immediately (we'll process per standard terms).
2) Early-pay pilot (30-day acceleration) — conditional approval pending W-9, ACH form, and a short finance eligibility check. Fee proposed: 1.0% per accelerated invoice.

To speed this up, here's what we'd need from Skyline to enroll in the pilot this week:
- Signed W-9 (PDF)
- Completed ACH authorization (signed)
- Signed initial PO (PDF) — use the attached Skyline_PO_0427.xlsx to create the PDF version
- Completion of the EarlyPay_Enrollment_Form (we've sent an editable PDF; DocuSign link below if easier)

DocuSign for enrollment: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC-123-ENVELOPE
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If you confirm the W-9 and ACH are on their way, Monica will send the portal invite and Karthik will route the enrollment to Finance for the 2–4 day decision window. If Finance approves, we can aim for first accelerated payment on your first cleared invoice after enrollment (target within 30 days).

Priya — are you ok with the 1.0% pilot fee? If so, reply with the attachments and we'll kick off the portal onboarding immediately.

Best,
